parent: complete frozen Stage1 f696 allocator plus b472 action/risk/recovery chain; 0bp IBKR Tiered own-state A_0 is attribution baseline; SOXX is final hard gate
motivation: Original Stage1 2026Q3 lost -0.1439008280 SOXL-relative selection log; 2025 lost -0.1580060123 cash opportunity log. This screen targets selection only and does not infer a cash switch from 2026Q3.
hypothesis: A stronger trailing SOXL product-tracking residual relative to a daily-reset 3x SOXX path predicts higher next-five-session SOXL-minus-SOXX open-return log advantage after the original Stage1 39 daily controls. Positive incremental coefficient is required.
feature: At signal-session close t, sum over the most recent 20 completed Qlib sessions of log(1+r_SOXL_close)-log(1+3*r_SOXX_close); use only at the next-session Stage1 09:29 ET decision. No sign, lag, window, threshold or model search.

receiver.label: five next session open-to-open log returns of SOXL minus SOXX from saved native Stage1 daily_frame, with saved timing maturity mask
receiver.baseline: original Stage1 39 daily features, SimpleImputer median, StandardScaler, Ridge alpha=1
receiver.candidate: same baseline plus one product_tracking_log20 coordinate, same rows and pipeline
receiver.null: training mean of matched mature relative label

gate.all_held: paired candidate-minus-baseline MSE improvement >0 and candidate-minus-train-mean improvement >0
gate.stability: candidate-minus-baseline paired MSE improvement >0 in both fixed chronological halves and each complete 2024 and 2025 calendar year
gate.uncertainty: full 944-session held calendar stationary-block bootstrap mean block 63, 2000 resamples, seed 20261023, one-sided alpha 0.025; paired candidate-minus-baseline lower bound >0
gate.decision: all gates required before any own-state 0bp account; failed fixed version closes without sign/window/cohort tuning

limitations: Price H5 information labels are not a funded fee-adjusted account. The 2023-2026 reuse is development feedback and cannot qualify independent forward evidence. Existing raw price/dividend conventions must pass source parity before fit.
